description:
Range and Equity Analysis Software for Hold'Em

Flopzilla is a Hold’em calculator, that has been designed to let you quickly and easily figure out how a range hits a board.
GTO+ export can now also export hand vs range. Pressing CTRL while clicking RESET will reset filters to default setting. Port number for sockets now stored in /config/settings.txt. Soft shadows instead of hard shadows. Added shadow to button text. Fixed visual glitch in case window was partially off-screen. Fixed visual glitch in case of zooming in too far. Various other minor changes and bug fixes.
